features.in_string: JSON-encoded TaskReq with cmd=query, configured UUID4 req_id, app_id=0, project_id=0, req="{}", config="{}"

records.authentication: Original FastAPI route has no authentication. Dedicated tenant instance behind an operator-reviewed authenticating proxy that strips credentials is required. No native Bearer capability is claimed.
records.query_semantics: sync_task cmd=query calls get_task_result; it reads TTLCache and does not submit work. get_task_result returns failed for missing or expired IDs, indistinguishable at status level from actual failed work. The cached result is opaque and never retained. The response task ID must match a digest of the configured private request ID.
records.privacy: Private UUID4 reference from VERDUGO_* environment; only a cryptographic binding enters plans. One strict task query serializer. No caller-selected task, query, endpoint, callback, model or submit command.
limitations: No task submission, model inference or polling scheduler
Completed status does not certify result quality or commercial success
Missing, expired and failed work are not distinguished
No original full KAG server or dependency closure has been executed or certified
The instance can evict or expire results; SQLite replay reports the earlier observation, not a fresh query
